Floating boxes

Alpha lines run beside the floating box, which takes the right part of the column, so that each of these lines ends well before the edge of the paragraph. The highlight of such a line must end before the box instead of covering it, while the text goes on and on around the box, line after line, with enough words to fill several lines next to it and a few more below it, where the lines get as wide as the column.

Omega lines run below the box, across the whole column, as wide as the paragraph itself, so that their highlight spans the column from one edge to the other, as it does on pages without any floats, and this paragraph is long enough to wrap onto a few lines of its own.
